original_mptrj.documented_purpose: The original dataset JSON was used to train CHGNet, with MP2020 compatibility corrections applied

energy_per_atom.attested_role: energy label used for CHGNet pretraining

corrected_total_energy.attested_role: VASP total after Materials Project 2020 compatibility

mace_public_documentation.mace_mp_claim_scope: MACE-MP pretrained models as described in public MACE documentation. This DOES NOT uniquely attest medium-mpa-0 training preprocessing.

research_inference.conflict: A CHGNet-corrected per-atom label is semantically different from an uncorrected raw VASP total energy. Even when numeric values coincide for some structures, the source field identities must not be conflated.
research_inference.structure_membership_separate_from_energ: Structure-only overlap analysis can be diagnostic without trusting a MACE-MPA-0 energy training label. Neither result alone authorizes an unseen claim.
research_inference.uncertainty: The exact MACE-MPA-0 energy-label preprocessing, selection, and checkpoint-bound source representation remain unknown.
